title: Gotrade Daily: 10-Year Yield Tops 5% as Trump Meets Xi
summary: The 10-year Treasury yield tops 5% as Trump and Xi meet. Your US watchlist for tonight: COST, AVGO, NVDA, TLT, and META.
body_markdown:
### Yield pressure on tech


Higher yields make growth-stock valuations look more expensive. Fed Governor Michael Barr said further rate hikes are likely needed to tame inflation, as reported by The Hill. Initial jobless claims at 8:30 a.m. ET and new home sales at 10:00 a.m. ET could move yields again.


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


US index futures are trading in a tight range in early Asian hours. Beyond the watchlist, **Darden Restaurants ([DRI](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/dri/) )** reports before the open, and **McDonald's ([MCD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/mcd/) )** raised its dividend by nearly 4%. SoftBank also sold $11.1 billion in bonds to fund its OpenAI investment. Per-stock pre-market moves will be updated closer to the US open.


## Macro Note 📝


Oil rose too. According to CNBC, Brent gained 3.86% to settle at $103.08 a barrel and WTI rose 1.81% to $92.16. Pricier oil adds to inflation pressure, keeping markets on edge about the Fed's next move.


## Conclusion


Tonight, markets weigh two opposing forces: yields above 5% and the chance of good news from the Trump-Xi talks. A concrete deal could ease pressure on tech, while strong economic data could push yields even higher.


For those watching US stocks, use TLT as a guide to rates, watch how NVDA and AVGO react to headlines from Washington, and read Costco's results as a check on the US consumer. Plan ahead before the session starts.
